evidence.V1: Front and silhouette read instantly as a heater shield (flat top, curved sides to a point) and the outline is mirror-symmetric (A15 X error 0.59 % < 1 %); three-quarter also reads clearly; top view is a thick slab with handle, as expected for a flat shield. Only blemish: rivets nearly fill the rim band, so they push small bumps out of the silhouette on the left edge.
evidence.V2: Clear hierarchy: big = shield body/plate, medium = chunky gold rim, raised teal field and centred star emblem, small = 7 steel rivets plus the stepped inner rim band; no noise.
evidence.V3: Confident stylised proportions: chunky rim, emblem about a third of field width, star centred (emblem_on_field offset 0.0005) and upright, rivets evenly and symmetrically spaced (corner/mid pairs within ~2 px of mirror in the front view).
evidence.V4: Consistent soft chamfers on rim outer edge, inner rim step, field edge and star arms; all catch a highlight line in the studio close-ups, matching the PASS anchor's edge treatment.
evidence.V5: Mostly clean smooth shading on rim, field and star, but the rivets are visibly faceted/lumpy (irregular polygonal outlines in rim_flat, egg-shaped top rivet in rim_studio) and the corner rivets straddle the step between the inner rim band and the field edge.
evidence.V6: Disciplined kit palette: gold rim in two values, single teal hue with a darker edge value, warm cream star, steel-grey rivets, dark handle; colourways (crimson, shadow) swap only the field hue and stay coherent.
evidence.V7: 1604 tris vs weapon target 2500 / ceiling 4000: under target.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material (LF_VertexColor), kit palette, chamfer scale and raised-field construction indistinguishable from the PASS anchor; rivets are an in-kit steel accent.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: origin at handle/grip point, CollisionFidelity Box, CanCollide off when equipped, Massless, MeshPart.Color white for vertex colours, SmoothPlastic; all gates A1-A18 pass.

artifacts: Rivets low-poly/faceted with irregular outlines in close-ups (rim_flat, rim_studio)
Corner rivets straddle the inner rim step / field edge and overhang the rim's outer edge, adding small bumps to the silhouette
top_fixes: Give rivets more segments (or a cleaner low-poly dome with smooth shading) so they read as round in close-ups
Shrink rivets ~15-20 % and centre them on the flat outer rim band so they neither cross the inner step nor break the outer outline
Optional: slightly recess the field edge into the rim (or add a thin ink-dark seam) so the raised plate reads less like a separate slab from three-quarter
